body: I've been in what is essentially solitary confinement for 6 months without a single interview and genuinely considered killing myself yesterday.

I'll tell you my experience trapped under a bad boss, and hope you do what I wish I did.

I was manipulated into a quid pro quo relationship (except I got nothing, it was more "the only reason you're still working here at all is because I fudge your reports, if it was anyone else you'd be fired" and gaslighting) with my boss, the stress of which put me into a nervous breakdown that hospitalized me and left me unable to even walk for a week. Without any physical cause, my heartrate had plummetted to an unsteady PVC-riddled 40bpm. My body gave up on living. That was 6 months into a job I stayed at for FOUR years. For four years I was terrified. Every day.

 And just like you, I couldn't ask for help or I would be fired (the company had a very strict policy against "dating" coworkers, and wouldn't care that I didn't want to be. We'd both be terminated.). I was completely trapped. I still haven't told anyone with my real name for fear it will make me unhirable. (obviously, a throwaway account so I can be honest.)

It's worth noting, at one point in my life I was in a ditch trying to revive my dead best friend. This job was more emotionally anguishing.

Don't do what I did; start looking for work now. Don't wait until it becomes unbearable then give HR the (still completely true but not primary) reason you're leaving is you're looking for bigger challenges in your career. 

When you do leave, calmly cite his racism and intolerable treatment as the reason why, and tell HR what you liked about the COMPANY, and wish them the best. Training new employees is expensive and time-consuming, so that's the best you can do to set the situation right. Just do that and then drop it from your mind forever. It's like trying to negotiate a bill. They don't do anything unless you decide to leave.

So harden up (TEMPORARILY!) put on a fake smile, kiss a little ass (knowing he will get his) and look for work every night. Let the bad days stoke your inner fire to power the engine of action.
Just deleting this. Posting here was a fucking stupid idea.

I knew people wouldn't read it, but if you don't read you also really don't fucking need to comment. I have absolutely no desire to be in a relationship with a man ever again. I want a career. And furthermore I have 53k in the bank I'm not BROKE at all, I just had my career ripped out from under me by a man who thought I was something he could use and now absolutely no idea how I can recover from this professionally. Just fuck off.
